\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.7}
\begin{cor}[{Segment integrals in a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-segments-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-segments-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, x.; \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, c) = (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, b, c)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-segments}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, c) = (\operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, a, b) + \operatorname{seg\text{-}int}(f, b, c)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.8}
\begin{prop}[{A primitive on a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-primitive-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-primitive-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, x.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-diff-on-of-eps-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall g \in (s \to \mathbb{C}), a \in s, l \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - a)) < d) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(((g(y) - g(a)) - ((y - a) \cdot l))) \leq (e \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((y - a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, s, g, a, l) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-continuous-at-add-const}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f, g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), k \in \mathbb{C}, y \in u. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) \simeq (f(z) + k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-primitive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.9}
\begin{cor}[{Cauchy's theorem on a convex set}]\label{thm:cauchy-convex-closed-except}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-closed-except}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, x, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad x \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(x)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{line-int-closed-road-of-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, m, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z, c(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(c, m, d, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.12}
\begin{prop}[{Principle of analytic continuation}]\label{thm:analytic-continuation}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{analytic-continuation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in u.\; f \text{ is analytic at } b \wedge \\ \quad \exists a \in u.\; \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-identity-principle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(z) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-zeros-local}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (f(z) = 0))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-zero-coefficients}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, f, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{analytic-continuation}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/analytic-\allowbreak{}continuation.scm} --- 12 recorded steps.}
%

The route differs from the notes: connectedness (connected-locally-constant) replaces the largest initial subpath of a polygonal path, and the local step shows that every Taylor coefficient at a vanishes instead of factoring f = (z - a)\textasciicircum{}n g with g(a) /= 0. holomorphic-identity-principle is the same statement for f holomorphic on u.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.13}
\begin{cor}[{Finitely many zeros in a closed ball}]\label{thm:analytic-zeros-finite-in-ball}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{analytic-zeros-finite-in-ball}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in u.\; f \text{ is analytic at } b \wedge \\ \quad \exists e \in u.\; \neg (f(e) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\{z \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = 0)\}| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{compact-cover-by-balls}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall h \in (s \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, s)) \wedge \forall x \in s.\; (0 < h(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \subseteq s) \wedge ((|p| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \forall y \in s.\; \exists x \in p.\; (y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, x, h(x))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.44}
\begin{prop}[{Weierstrass: uniform limits on compacta of holomorphic functions are holomorphic}]\label{thm:holomorphic-limit-on-compacta}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-limit-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-limit-derivatives}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{wcvk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, m(\mathit{wcvk}), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unif-on-compacta-locally}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{locally-uniform-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, l. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(k)(y) - l(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, g, l) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-closed-ball-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.1}
\begin{lem}[{An exhaustive sequence of compact sets}]\label{thm:cc-exhaust-exhaustive}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-exhaustive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge ((p \subseteq u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-subset}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \subseteq u)}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-interior}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n) \subseteq \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-mono}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (a \leq b) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, a) \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-covers}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.2}
\begin{prop}[{C(U) is a Frechet space for uniform convergence on compacta}]\label{thm:cc-cont-fns-frechet}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-cont-fns-frechet}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-fn-module-is-module}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-seminorms-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-uniform-iff-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(z) - f(z))) \leq s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-fr-conv-iff-unif-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.3}
\begin{prop}[{H(U) is closed in C(U)}]\label{thm:cc-hol-fns-closed}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-fns-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-fns-subset-cont}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.7}
\begin{thm}[{Montel: bounded closed subsets of H(U) are compact}]\label{thm:cc-montel}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \operatorname{subseq}(s, i), g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel-subsequence}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(i)(z) - \operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(j)(z))) < b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel-tail}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-pointwise-diagonal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, d. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists a \in \mathbb{R}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(s(k)(z)) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(i(\mathit{cmk}))(d(j))), \ell) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.8}
\begin{prop}[{Bounded subsets of H(U) are equicontinuous}]\label{thm:cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a.; \forall b \in u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall f \in a, z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - b)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(b))) < s))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-holomorphic-deriv-estimate}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall y \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-holomorphic-lipschitz-at-centre}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(c))) \leq ((m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.19}
\begin{cor}[{A bounded pointwise convergent sequence in H(U) converges uniformly on compacta}]\label{thm:cc-montel-pointwise-limit}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(z)), g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.20}
\begin{prop}[{Differentiation is continuous on H(U)}]\label{thm:cc-deriv-cont-lin}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-cont-lin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-fn-module-is-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-continuous-on-hol}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, s(k), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-linear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; ((a \cdot f(w)) + (b \cdot g(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad =\; (a \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z)) + (b \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.21}
\begin{lem}[{The seminorms of f' are bounded by seminorms of f}]\label{thm:cc-deriv-seminorm-estimate}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-seminorm-estimate}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, ((4 \cdot n) + 3)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot (4 \cdot (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-ball-inside}}

%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.22}
\begin{prop}[{Normally convergent series of holomorphic functions differentiate term by term}]\label{thm:cc-series-holomorphic}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-series-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-derived-series-normally-convergent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(i), z))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-normal-convergence-uniform}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s, a. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z)), n))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-normal-convergence-pointwise}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s.; \forall z \in s. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-partial-sums-diff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad z, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z)), n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.23}
\begin{prop}[{Hurwitz's theorem}]\label{thm:cc-hurwitz}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz-local}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, c \in u, p, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad f(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (((x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, p)) \wedge \neg (x = c)) \Rightarrow \neg (f(x) = a)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow \exists z \in u.\; ((z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge (s(k)(z) = a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\begin{rem}[{Hurwitz's theorem for a value a, and its contrapositive}]\label{thm:cc-hurwitz-value}
%

\begin{lem}[{Causal precedence in a bundle is a partial order with minimal elements}]\label{thm:precedes-partial-order}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{precedes-partial-order}}
\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}partial\text{-}order}(\operatorname{bnodes}(c), \operatorname{precedes}(c)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{finite-strict-minimal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \forall x, y, z.\; (((\langle x, y \rangle \in r) \wedge (\langle y, z \rangle \in r)) \Rightarrow (\langle x, z \rangle \in r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x.\; \neg (\langle x, x \rangle \in r) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \exists w.\; (w \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg (\langle z, m \rangle \in r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bundle-minimal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \exists w.\; (w \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg (\langle z, m \rangle \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.8}
\begin{lem}[{A minimal node of a content-closed node set is a sent node}]\label{thm:bundle-minimal-sent}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in s \wedge \\ \quad n \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg (\langle z, n \rangle \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{The adversary bound: a secret that never originates on a regular node occurs nowhere}]\label{thm:adversary-bound}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{adversary-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, u.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{adversary-bound-adversary-nodes}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, u.; \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \neg \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{adversary-node-origin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}infiltrated\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{nodes}(\operatorname{ispace}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}adversary\text{-}node}(p, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(p), u, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(p) \end{array}}

The adversary has the traces M F T C S E D over the space (C and S n-ary over lists; D decrypts under KINV; the paper's K trace is subsumed by M since keys are tokens). The proof is the paper's method -- a minimal member of \{n in C : u @ content(n)\} by Lemma 2.7, originating by 2.9, sent by 2.8, hence an adversary node, then seven cases -- with two findings: the M and C cases rest on the TOKEN LAW (no token is a list), not on the freeness of a free algebra; and the E case holds under either subterm convention, the convention deciding only whether the hypothesis 'never originates regularly' can be met for a key a participant encrypts with. \noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} On the user's model; the hypotheses 'C-height 3', 'K\_A\textasciicircum{}-1 not in K\_P', 'Na /= Nb', 'Nb uniquely originating' as the paper's. The paper's inner argument of Lemma 5.4 case S (the set T) is the theorem nsl-list-source; its 'no regular node contains an encrypted term as a proper subterm' is nsl-regular-encr-subterm; Lemma 2.8 does not apply to T as the paper says, the weaker bundle-minimal-sent-back does.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.8}
\begin{prop}[{Injectivity: at most one initiator strand for a uniquely originating Na}]\label{thm:nsl-init-unique}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nsl-init-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a, b, c, d, f, g, a_{2}, b_{2}, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), f) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(a), c, d, f, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(b), a_{2}, b_{2}, f, h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nsl-init-nonce-originates}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, t, a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pk\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), c, \langle 1, t \rangle) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.14}
\begin{prop}[{The initiator's agreement guarantee}]\label{thm:nsl-initiator-agreement}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, c, s, a, b, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nsl\text{-}space}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{bspace}(c) = \operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}init\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(s), a, b, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \langle 3, s \rangle \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(a)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{kinv}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(\operatorname{pubkey}(p)(b)) \in \operatorname{adv\text{-}tokens}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{uniquely\text{-}originates}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in \operatorname{ids}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p))). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}resp\text{-}strand}(p, \operatorname{strand\text{-}map}(\operatorname{ispace}(\operatorname{pk\text{-}inf}(p)))(t), a, b, d, f) \wedge (\langle 2, t \rangle \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c))) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.13}
\begin{thm}[{The monotone class theorem}]\label{thm:monotone-class-theorem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{monotone-class-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, c, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}monotone\text{-}class}(a, c) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, e) \wedge (e \subseteq c))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(a, e) \subseteq c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebra-monotone-union-sigma-algebra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebra\text{-}of\text{-}sets}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(k, \mathbb{N}, f(k)) \in b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.17}
\begin{prop}[{Continuity of a measure from below}]\label{thm:measure-continuity-from-below}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge ((f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b)) \wedge \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f(n) \subseteq f((n + 1))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, f(n))) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.18}
\begin{prop}[{Continuity of a measure from above}]\label{thm:measure-continuity-from-above}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (f((n + 1)) \subseteq f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad u(f(0)) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(a, f(n))))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.16}
\begin{prop}[{The monotone convergence theorem}]\label{thm:monotone-convergence}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, f(n), f((n + 1))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, f)) = \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f(n))), \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/integral-\allowbreak{}convergence.scm} --- 205 recorded steps.}
%

%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{ineq}, \texttt{crs}, \texttt{arith}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.28}
\begin{prop}[{The dominated convergence theorem}]\label{thm:dominated-convergence}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{dominated-convergence}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, c(n), g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(n)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c(n))), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fatou}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f(n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}liminf}(a, f)) \leq \operatorname{eliminf}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f(n)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{dominated-convergence}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.4}
\begin{prop}[{The Caratheodory theorem}]\label{thm:caratheodory-measurable-sigma-algebra}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{caratheodory-measurable-sigma-algebra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{caratheodory-measure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u), \operatorname{res}(u, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{caratheodory-null-measurable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge ((s \subseteq a) \wedge (u(s) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, u, s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{caratheodory-superadditive-suffices}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \forall \alpha \in \operatorname{power}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eplus}(u((\alpha \cap s)), u(\operatorname{difference}(\alpha, s))) \leq u(\alpha) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, u, s) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.10}
\begin{prop}[{The outer measure extending a measure}]\label{thm:method-i-outer-extends}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-extends}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(c) = o(c)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-measurable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (c \in b)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-null-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) = 0) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-finite-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}caratheodory\text{-}measurable}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in b.\; ((s \subseteq y) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(y, s))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-of-measure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge (s \in \operatorname{power}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists \mathit{osa} \in b.\; ((s \subseteq \mathit{osa}) \wedge (v = o(\mathit{osa})))\}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.11}
\begin{cor}[{The Caratheodory measure of mu* is complete and extends the completion of rho}]\label{thm:method-i-outer-caratheodory-complete}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-caratheodory-complete}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{method-i-outer-extends-completion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, o, c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, o) \wedge ((c \in b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, o, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (c \cup s) \in \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(a, b, o)))((c \cup s)) = o(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{caratheodory-measure-complete}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(a, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}measure}(a, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u), \operatorname{res}(u, \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(a, u))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.27}
\begin{lem}[{A metric outer measure is additive on a positively separated sequence}]\label{thm:metric-outer-measure-separated-sum}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{metric-outer-measure-separated-sum}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, s(k), s(l)) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, s(n))) = \operatorname{esum}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(s(n)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{metric-outer-measure-finite-separated}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, s.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{set\text{-}dist}(m, s(k), s(l)) = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(n), s(j))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, (\lambda a \in \mathbb{N}.\; u(s(a))), \mathrm{OS}(n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.28}
\begin{lem}[{The layers of the complement of a closed set}]\label{thm:metric-outer-layers-limit}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, u, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}outer\text{-}measure}(m, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(m, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((n + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}(((n + 1) + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \quad u((a \cap \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(m), l))) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\operatorname{image}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; u((a \cap \{x \in \operatorname{pts}(m) : (\operatorname{recip}((k + 1)) \leq \operatorname{pt\text{-}set\text{-}dist}(m, x, l))\}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathbb{N})) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in s)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\begin{thm}[{Uniqueness of Lebesgue measure on the Borel sets}]\label{thm:lebesgue-measure-unique}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s) \end{array}}

\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.17}
\begin{prop}[{Hoelder's inequality}]\label{thm:hoelder}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hoelder}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < p \wedge \\ \quad 1 < q \wedge \\ \quad (/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}etimes}(a, f, g)) \leq \operatorname{etimes}(I_{p}({f}), I_{q}({g})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{young-extended}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}, p, q \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((1 < p) \wedge ((1 < q) \wedge ((/(1, p) + /(1, q)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{etimes}(a, b) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(\operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{recip}(p), {a}^{p}), \operatorname{etimes}(\operatorname{recip}(q), {b}^{q})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.19}
\begin{prop}[{Minkowski's inequality}]\label{thm:minkowski}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge (1 \leq p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)}) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(I_{p}({f}), I_{p}({g})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.21}
\begin{prop}[{Functions equal almost everywhere have the same integral}]\label{thm:integral-ae-eq}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{integral-ae-eq}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in b \wedge \\ \quad u(c) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in c) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) = \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rintegral-ae-eq}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, g) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, g) = \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.23}
\begin{prop}[{A function with finite integral is finite almost everywhere}]\label{thm:integral-finite-ae-finite}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f) < \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\{x \in a : (f(x) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\} \in b) \wedge (u(\{x \in a : (f(x) = \operatorname{pos\text{-}inf})\}) = 0) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.24}
\begin{prop}[{A function with nonnegative integral over every measurable set is nonnegative almost everywhere}]\label{thm:rintegral-nonneg-on-sets-null}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{rintegral-nonneg-on-sets-null}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in b. \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, (\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{indicator}(a, c)(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, \{\mathit{nx} \in a : (f(\mathit{nx}) < 0)\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rintegral-decomposition}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (a \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (c(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (d(x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; (f(x) = (c(x) - d(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, d) \in \mathbb{R} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(a, b, u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(a, b, u, f) = (\operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c) - \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, d)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.22}
\begin{thm}[{The L\textasciicircum{}p seminorm}]\label{thm:lp-norm-triangle}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-triangle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))}\|_{p} \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{eplus}(\|{f}\|_{p}, \|{g}\|_{p}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-homogeneous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (c \cdot f(x)))}\|_{p} = \operatorname{etimes}(\lvert c \rvert, \|{f}\|_{p}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-zero-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{sx}) - g(\mathit{sx})))}\|_{p} = 0 \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.5}
\begin{prop}[{Sections of a product-measurable function are measurable}]\label{thm:x-section-measurable}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{x-section-measurable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, d, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge ((d \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c)) \wedge (x \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{x\text{-}section}(b, d, x) \in c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fn-x-section-measurable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{fn\text{-}x\text{-}section}(b, f, x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fn-y-section-measurable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \wedge \\ \quad y \in b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{fn\text{-}y\text{-}section}(s, f, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.7}
\begin{thm}[{Fubini}]\label{thm:fubini}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{fubini}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(s, a, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(b, c, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{integral}(s, a, u, \operatorname{x\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, b, c, d, f)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}integral}(s, a, u, b, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fubini-sets}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fubini\text{-}set}(s, a, u, b, c, d, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dynkin-pi-lambda}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, d, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dynkin\text{-}system}(a, d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}pi\text{-}system}(p) \wedge (p \subseteq d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(a, p) \subseteq d \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.8}
\begin{defn}[{The product measure}]\label{thm:product-measure-is-measure}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{product-measure-is-measure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}((s \times b), \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c), \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{product-measure-symmetric}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(s, a, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(b, c, d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in \operatorname{product\text{-}sigma}(s, a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)(f) = \operatorname{integral}(b, c, d, \operatorname{y\text{-}section\text{-}measure}(s, b, u, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{product-measure-rectangle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, u, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(s, a, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(b, c, d) \wedge ((f \in a) \wedge (g \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{product\text{-}measure}(s, a, u, b, c, d)((f \times g)) = \operatorname{etimes}(u(f), d(g)) \end{array}}
%
\end{defn}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.2 (corollary)}
\begin{cor}[{A translation-invariant Borel measure on the line is a multiple of Lebesgue measure}]\label{thm:lebesgue-translation-invariant}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lebesgue-translation-invariant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, k, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall v, c. \\ \quad \quad ((v \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v + c) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad u((v + c)) = u(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < k \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ccint}(0, 1)) = k \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{etimes}(k, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{esum-scale}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, d.; \forall f \in (d \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}). \\ \quad (0 \leq c) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{esum}((\lambda z \in d.\; \operatorname{etimes}(c, f(z)))) = \operatorname{etimes}(c, \operatorname{esum}(f))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{measure-scale}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u.; \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (0 \leq c)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, (\lambda x \in b.\; \operatorname{etimes}(c, u(x)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.24-8.26}
\begin{prop}[{Seminormed spaces with a countable family: the metric}]\label{thm:frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-scal-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(d)), b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)), l \in \operatorname{carr}(d), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d), s, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), b, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(m)(s(n), b(n))), \operatorname{act}(m)(l, x)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.30}
\begin{thm}[{Open mapping theorem for Frechet spaces}]\label{thm:open-mapping-theorem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-bounded-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(t(x)) = x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; (t(g(y)) = y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(c, f, a, b, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
