\begin{thm}[{Banach-Steinhaus for Frechet spaces}]\label{thm:frechet-banach-steinhaus}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}equicont}(a, b, c, f, g, h) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/frechet-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}steinhaus.scm} --- 121 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{frm-fam-field}, \texttt{fbs-uniform-ball}, \texttt{nf-norm-in-rr}, \texttt{rr-pos-rr-in-rr}, \texttt{rr-lt-of-pos-rr}, \texttt{rr-zero-in}, \texttt{rr-lt-irrefl}, \texttt{rr-recip-closed}, \texttt{rr-recip-pos}, \texttt{rr-mul-closed}, \texttt{rr-mul-pos}, \texttt{rr-pos-rr-of-lt}, \texttt{fbs-ball-bound}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{ineq}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{crs}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.19}
\begin{prop}[{Orthogonal projection onto a closed subspace of a Hilbert space}]\label{thm:hilbert-projection-exists}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-projection-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k, b \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (i = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-decomposition-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad b_{1} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad b_{2} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1}) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} = a_{2}) \wedge (b_{1} = b_{2}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{hilbert-projection-exists}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection.scm} --- 224 recorded steps.}
%

%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.22}
\begin{thm}[{Riesz representation}]\label{thm:riesz-representation}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot \lVert x \rVert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert e \rVert \leq c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, e_{1}, e_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{1})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e_{1} = e_{2} \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{riesz-representation}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection.scm} --- 44 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{hilbert-space-is-cips}, \texttt{riesz-representation-exists}, \texttt{cips-ip-magnitude-le}, \texttt{cips-ip-bound-least}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{crs}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{ineq}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-unique}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection.scm} --- 16 recorded steps.}

%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{crs}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{ineq}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{Hahn-Banach}
\begin{thm}[{Hahn-Banach for a sublinear functional}]\label{thm:hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq p(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(x) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-seminorm-rr}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(a(x)) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-seminorm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge \\ \quad (d = \operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \vee (d = \operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge (\operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a(x)) \leq p(x)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hahn-\allowbreak{}banach-\allowbreak{}sublinear.scm} --- 82 recorded steps.}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.18}
\begin{prop}[{Cauchy-Schwarz inequality}]\label{thm:sip-schwarz}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/sip-\allowbreak{}a.scm} --- 238 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{sip-scal-pin}, \texttt{sip-rip-type}, \texttt{sip-rip-self-nonneg}, \texttt{rr-mul-closed}, \texttt{rr-add-closed}, \texttt{rr-neg-closed}, \texttt{sip-expand-two}, \texttt{rr-zero-mul}, \texttt{rr-mul-le-cancel-pos}, \texttt{rr-mul-zero}, \texttt{rr-not-le-lt}, \texttt{rr-sub-in-rr}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{ineq}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{crs}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}
%
\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Stated for a positive SEMIdefinite form (SEMI-INNER-PRODUCT-SPACE), squared: $<$x,y$>$\textasciicircum{}2 $<$= $<$x,x$>$$<$y,y$>$. The proof avoids the notes' division by $<$eta,eta$>$, which may vanish for a nonzero eta in the semidefinite case.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.19}
\begin{prop}[{The norm of a pre-Hilbert space}]\label{thm:sip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}}
\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y))} \leq (\sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)} + \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-metric-space-is-metric-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.20}
\begin{prop}[{Closest point of a closed convex set}]\label{thm:real-convex-closest-point-unique}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-point-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \wedge \\ \quad b \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-iff-variational}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \leq 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} C is required NONEMPTY (for C empty the notes' statement is false). Closest is minimality of the squared distance, |a - x|\textasciicircum{}2 $<$= |b - x|\textasciicircum{}2 for every b in C, not an infimum. Existence goes through the complexification of H and the complex closest-point theorem for a midpoint-closed set (hilbert-closest-point-midpoint), not through the notes' minimizing sequence. The variational characterisation real-convex-closest-iff-variational is not in the notes.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.23}
\begin{prop}[{Complex polarization identity}]\label{thm:ses-polarization}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\begin{prop}[{Antisymmetric, isometric, square minus the identity: any two give the third}]\label{thm:sip-isometric-of-antisym-sq}

\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-isometric-of-antisym-sq}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall o \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}antisymmetric\text{-}op}(v, o) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}square\text{-}minus\text{-}id}(v, o))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}isometric\text{-}op}(v, o) \end{array}}
